# `modules/EditorPhysicalMaterial.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/modules/EditorPhysicalMaterial.js`

============================================================================ EditorPhysicalMaterial.js — Runtime bridge for physical material simulation  Connects PhysicalMaterial ECS component to existing physics systems: - Collision → damage accumulation - Damage exceeds threshold → deform (voxel crater) or fracture (Voronoi) - Fracture spawns real ECS entities with Renderable + PhysicsBody + Collider - Material-specific debris FX (dust, sparks, splinters) - Fragment count scales with impact energy - Brittleness determines shatter vs bend behavior  Lazy-loads heavy modules (VoronoiFracture, AutoTetMesh) only when triggered. ============================================================================

## Functions

### `clearPlayState()`

Clear all play-session state. Must be called when exiting play mode so that damage/fracture/deformation caches don't persist into the next session.

### `setupPhysicalMaterialBridge(editor)`

### `handleCollision(editor, entityIdA, entityIdB, impactForce, contactPoint, contactNormal, massA, massB)`

Handle a collision between two entities. Called from EditorPhysics.js contact callback.

**Parameters:**

- `editor` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `entityIdA` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `entityIdB` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `impactForce` *(number)* — — magnitude of collision impulse
- `contactPoint` *(number[])* — — [x, y, z] world-space contact
- `contactNormal` *(number[])* — — [nx, ny, nz] collision normal

### `applyDamage(editor, entityId, amount)`

Apply direct damage to an entity (e.g., from explosions, scripts).

### `resetDamage(editor, entityId)`

Reset damage on an entity.

### `async convertToSoftBody(editor, entityId)`

Convert a rigid entity to a soft body on-the-fly. Uses AutoTetMesh to generate tet volume, then PBD solver.

### `async deformAtImpact(editor, entityId, contactPoint, contactNormal, normalizedForce)`

Deform mesh at impact point by carving a crater via voxel subtraction. If the carve disconnects pieces, broken-off pieces become fragment entities.

### `async fractureEntity(editor, entityId, contactPoint, contactNormal, impactForce, normalizedForce)`

Fracture an entity into visible fragment ECS entities using VoronoiFracture. Each fragment gets its own Renderable, PhysicsBody, and Collider. Fragment count scales with impact energy (Phase D).

### `updateDebris(editor)`

Update debris lifecycle — call from physics step. Removes expired debris entities.

### `syncColliderFromMaterial(editor, entityId)`

Sync collider friction/restitution from material properties. Call after material changes.

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```
